mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_trade_history ( trade_date, symbol, market, entry_mode, entry_price, entry_qty, entry_time, entry_signal_score, entry_vwap_dist_pct, entry_velocity_sht, exit_price, exit_qty, exit_time, exit_reason, exit_type, hold_seconds, pnl_amount, pnl_pct, weighted_pnl, peak_pnl_pct, fee_amount, slippage_pct, is_partial ) VALUES ( #{tradeDate}, #{symbol}, #{market}, #{entryMode}, #{entryPrice}, #{entryQty}, #{entryTime}, #{entrySignalScore}, #{entryVwapDistPct}, #{entryVelocitySht}, #{exitPrice}, #{exitQty}, #{exitTime}, #{exitReason}, #{exitType}, #{holdSeconds}, #{pnlAmount}, #{pnlPct}, #{weightedPnl}, #{peakPnlPct}, #{feeAmount}, #{slippagePct}, #{partial} )
mapper.update: INSERT INTO tb_trade_mode_daily_stats ( stat_date, market, entry_mode, trade_count, win_count, loss_count, win_rate, avg_profit_pct, avg_loss_pct, expectancy_pct, total_pnl_pct, total_pnl_amount, avg_hold_seconds, avg_vwap_dist_pct, avg_velocity_sht, breakout_fail_cnt ) SELECT h.trade_date, h.market, h.entry_mode, COUNT(*) AS trade_count, SUM(h.pnl_pct > 0) AS win_count, SUM(h.pnl_pct <= 0) AS loss_count, SUM(h.pnl_pct > 0) / COUNT(*) AS win_rate, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN h.pnl_pct > 0 THEN h.pnl_pct END), 0) AS avg_profit_pct, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN h.pnl_pct <= 0 THEN h.pnl_pct END), 0) AS avg_loss_pct, (SUM(h.pnl_pct > 0) / COUNT(*)) * COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN h.pnl_pct > 0 THEN h.pnl_pct END), 0) + (SUM(h.pnl_pct <= 0) / COUNT(*)) * COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN h.pnl_pct <= 0 THEN h.pnl_pct END), 0) AS expectancy_pct, SUM(h.pnl_pct) AS total_pnl_pct, SUM(h.pnl_amount) AS total_pnl_amount, ROUND(AVG(h.hold_seconds)) AS avg_hold_seconds, AVG(h.entry_vwap_dist_pct) AS avg_vwap_dist_pct, AVG(h.entry_velocity_sht) AS avg_velocity_sht, SUM(h.exit_reason = 'FAILED_BREAKOUT') AS breakout_fail_cnt FROM tb_trade_history h WHERE h.trade_date = #{tradeDate} GROUP BY h.trade_date, h.market, h.entry_mode ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE trade_count = VALUES(trade_count), win_count = VALUES(win_count), loss_count = VALUES(loss_count), win_rate = VALUES(win_rate), avg_profit_pct = VALUES(avg_profit_pct), avg_loss_pct = VALUES(avg_loss_pct), expectancy_pct = VALUES(expectancy_pct), total_pnl_pct = VALUES(total_pnl_pct), total_pnl_amount = VALUES(total_pnl_amount), avg_hold_seconds = VALUES(avg_hold_seconds), avg_vwap_dist_pct = VALUES(avg_vwap_dist_pct), avg_velocity_sht = VALUES(avg_velocity_sht), breakout_fail_cnt = VALUES(breakout_fail_cnt), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
